source.title: Lurgan Mail, 21 September 1946, p. 5 ("Rural council elections: Lurgan and Moira nominations")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Unopposed nominations from the Lurgan Mail (21 September 1946, p. 5) and Dromore Weekly Times (21 September 1946, p. 5).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. There were no contests: one nomination was received for each of six divisions and none for Magheralin, whose retiring member was deemed re-elected. Returned unopposed.
